Two copies of one invented profile page, written by hand in the shape of a code hosting
profile. The person, the handle, the employer and every address are invented.

- older.html: the earlier capture. It has a bio line, a location, an employer and two links
  that the later one lacks.
- newer.html: the later capture. The bio is shorter and one link is new.

Both hold things a reader must not pass on: a script, a style block, a link to an adult site,
a picture link, a `javascript:` link and a control character.
